article.title: 酒店AI搜尋研究：提及份額分散，3.1%並非預訂市佔
article.title_en: Hotel AI-search study finds fragmented mentions, not booking market share
article.summary: Zen Media於10月30日公布美國市場研究：1,000條旅客問題產生3,015個AI答案，Expedia佔公司提及次數3.1%。
article.summary_en: Zen Media’s October 30 US study analyzed 3,015 AI answers to 1,000 traveler questions; Expedia held 3.1% of company mentions.
article.why: 酒店可按旅客需求檢查AI推薦，而非把單一總排名當作品牌表現。
article.why_en: Hotels can audit recommendations by traveler need instead of treating one aggregate ranking as brand performance.
article.next_step: 建立家庭、商務及養生需求樣本，記錄引述來源、日期與引擎。
article.next_step_en: Sample family, business and wellness queries and record citations, dates and engines.
highlights: 資料於10月28日收集，涵蓋ChatGPT、Gemini及Grok。
份額分母是13,194次公司提及，並非答案數、旅客或交易。
highlights_en: Collection on October 28 covered ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok.
The denominator is 13,194 company mentions, not answers, travelers or transactions.
article.detail:
Zen Media於10月30日公布美國市場研究：1,000條旅客問題產生3,015個AI答案，Expedia佔公司提及次數3.1%。

資料於10月28日收集，涵蓋ChatGPT、Gemini及Grok。

份額分母是13,194次公司提及，並非答案數、旅客或交易。

酒店可按旅客需求檢查AI推薦，而非把單一總排名當作品牌表現。

建立家庭、商務及養生需求樣本，記錄引述來源、日期與引擎。

這是提供AI可見度服務公司的單日樣本，非獨立重現或香港市場結果，亦不能證明內容優化帶來預訂。
article.detail_en:
Zen Media’s October 30 US study analyzed 3,015 AI answers to 1,000 traveler questions; Expedia held 3.1% of company mentions.

Collection on October 28 covered ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok.

The denominator is 13,194 company mentions, not answers, travelers or transactions.

Hotels can audit recommendations by traveler need instead of treating one aggregate ranking as brand performance.

Sample family, business and wellness queries and record citations, dates and engines.

This is a visibility vendor’s single-day sample, not an independently reproduced or Hong Kong result; it establishes no booking lift.
